what: joint.find_limits of a slider whose block runs into a stop at each end
method: Frame (grounded): stops 10x10x10 at x -30..-20 and 50..60; Carriage: box 40x10x10 at x 0..40, same y and z; a slider along +x at value 0. Up, its end x = 40 meets the right stop at x = 50: max 10; down, its end x = 0 meets the left stop at x = -20: min -20. Each side stops at the last value clear of contact, bisected to refine 0.01 mm: within 0.02 mm. Every face is flat, so the mesh gap is exact (gap_tolerance_mm 0)
